summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute the bundled math_init.js — a 727KB Bun-compiled script with string-array rotation obfuscation (rotator function WV8StW over a large constant array n7gIxM, mangled identifiers) unrelated to the package's advertised React component purpose. The payload runs on npm install with the installer's privileges via the alternate-runtime execution path (Bun rather than Node), bypassing tooling that inspects only Node-resolved code. The package name @hubsync/web-sdk-react, description 'Verdocs Web SDK for React', and README instructing installation of @verdocs/web-sdk-react together form a typosquat lure: the tarball contents appear cloned from the legitimate Verdocs SDK with the preinstall dropper added on top.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
